meta.name: autonomous-skill
meta.description: Execute long-running, multi-session tasks autonomously using Claude Code headless mode or in-session hook-based loops. Supports structured task decomposition (for complex projects) and lightweight Ralph-style iteration (for TDD, bug fixing, refactoring). Use this skill whenever the user says "autonomous", "long-running task", "multi-session", "run this in the background", "keep working on this", "batch process", "iterate until done", "ralph loop", or wants any task that requires sustained, unattended execution.

copy.tagline: 让复杂任务在后台自动持续执行
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要让AI在无人值守下长时间运行多步骤任务
copy.tagline_en: Run complex tasks autonomously in the background
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need AI to run multi-step tasks unattended for long periods

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以自动执行需要多个会话才能完成的长任务，比如构建应用、修复测试、重构代码。它会自动分解任务、记录进度，并在完成后停止。
howto.when: 当你说出“autonomous”、“long-running task”、“run this in the background”等关键词，或者要求执行需要持续无人值守的任务时触发。

say.text: autonomous 帮我构建一个待办事项应用的 REST API。
say.note: Claude 会分解任务并自动执行多个会话。
Claude 会从上次中断的地方继续。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can autonomously execute long-running tasks that require multiple sessions, such as building applications, fixing tests, or refactoring code. It automatically decomposes tasks, tracks progress, and stops when complete.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "autonomous", "long-running task", "run this in the background", or similar keywords, or when you request a task that requires sustained unattended execution.

say_en.text: autonomous Build a REST API for a todo app.
say_en.note: Claude will decompose the task and execute multiple sessions automatically.

say_en.text: autonomous --lightweight Fix all failing tests in src/.
say_en.note: Claude will iterate until all tests pass.

say_en.text: autonomous --continue Continue the most recent task.
say_en.note: Claude will resume from where it left off.
